questions: Should the function raise an error if remove_cols contains duplicate indices, or silently deduplicate them?
If remove_cols contains an index out of range (e.g., 10 when there are only 5 columns), should the function raise an error or ignore it?
Should the function handle negative indices (e.g., -1 to refer to the last column) in remove_cols?
Is the order of columns in the output DataFrame required to be the same as the original order, excluding removed columns?
If random_seed is None, should the random number generator be left in an unspecified state, or should it be reset to avoid side effects?
Should the function validate that n_rows is a non-negative integer, and if not, what behavior is expected?
If columns is an empty list, what should happen? Should an empty DataFrame be created, or should an error be raised?
